# Cache-Control Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on Vary: * (uncacheable forever), Cache-Control: public alongside a Set-Cookie header (a shared cache can leak one visitor's cookie to another), and lower-severity caching directive conflicts.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
